ledger.claim: The proposed agentic memory-based evaluator achieves a better accuracy-efficiency tradeoff than existing memory- and LLM-based approaches.
ledger.quote: the proposed evaluator offers a better accuracy-efficiency tradeoff compared to existing memory- and LLM-based approaches under this evaluation setting.
ledger.label: inferred

ledger.claim: ATOD has average 54 turns per dialogue, supporting async execution, dependency modeling, interleaving, proactive behaviors, and turn-level goal status annotation — the only benchmark with all five features.
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: The co-occurrence graph is built from SGD and contains 52 nodes, 396 edges, density 0.2986, average degree 15.23, max degree 29, min degree 2.
ledger.quote: Total Nodes (Unique Goals) 52 / Total Edges (Co-occurrences) 396 / Graph Density 0.2986 / Average Degree 15.23 / Max Degree 29 / Min Degree 2
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Goal sequences extracted from SGD: 10,739 total, average length 3.90, range 2–8, 16 unique domains, 37 unique intents.
ledger.quote: Total Goal Sequences 10,739 / Avg. Sequence Length 3.90 / Length Range 2–8 / Unique Domains 16 / Unique Intents 37
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Dependency-Aware Goal Completion Rate (dGCR) is the primary task-completion metric, defined as the fraction of completed goals among those in decided states (Completed or Failed), excluding dependency-locked goals.
ledger.quote: dGCR = |{g∈U:S(g)=Completed}| / |Udec| ... This formulation avoids bias from dependency-locked goals and provides a faithful measure of system performance in multi-goal workflows.
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Proactivity Effectiveness identifies goal or state changes initiated without explicit user prompts and assesses whether these actions are contextually appropriate.
ledger.quote: We evaluate proactive behaviors by identifying goal or state changes initiated without explicit user prompts and assessing whether these actions are contextually appropriate and beneficial.
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Response quality is assessed via turn-level relevance and dialogue-level coherence.
ledger.quote: we assess conversational quality, focusing on turn-level relevance and dialogue-level coherence, following prior work.
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Metric validity is assessed via Pearson's r and Spearman's ρ correlation with dGCR. Memory Recall Accuracy correlates most strongly (medium: r=0.75, ρ=0.60; complex: r=0.44, ρ=0.43).
ledger.quote: Among all metrics, Memory Recall Accuracy correlates most strongly with dGCR in both settings... Memory Recall Accuracy / Medium: r+0.75 ρ+0.60 / Complex: r+0.44 ρ+0.43
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Evaluation splits are broken down by dialogue complexity (medium vs. complex); results in Table 3 are averaged over the test set.
ledger.quote: All results are reported as percentages (%) and averaged over the test set.
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Goal detection is evaluated with F1 score; status tracking with accuracy. The proposed agentic memory system achieves Goal Detection F1 of 91.92% (medium) / 86.49% (complex) and Status Tracking Acc. of 92.31% / 84.28%.
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Average metric values on the test set: dGCR 0.967 (medium) / 0.930 (complex); NTC 7.04 / 10.50; Memory Recall Accuracy 0.913 / 0.743; Proactivity Effectiveness 0.619 / 0.586; Turn-level Quality 0.752 / 0.766; Dialogue-level Quality 4.40 / 4.45.
ledger.quote: dGCR 0.967 0.930 / # Turns to Completion 7.04 10.50 / Memory Recall Accuracy 0.913 0.743 / Proactivity Effectiveness 0.619 0.586 / Turn-level Quality 0.752 0.766 / Dialogue-level Quality 4.40 4.45
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: The dataset is constructed synthetically using an LLM pipeline seeded from the public SGD dataset; it contains no real user data or PII.
ledger.quote: Since the dataset is constructed via an LLM-driven pipeline using the public Schema-Guided Dialogue (SGD) dataset as a seed, it does not contain real user data or Personally Identifiable Information (PII).
ledger.label: unknown

ledger.claim: ATOD-Eval supports both offline benchmark analysis and online tracking across static datasets and real-time deployments.
ledger.quote: ATOD-Eval supports both offline benchmark analysis and online tracking, enabling consistent assessment across static datasets and real-time deployments.
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Per-turn update latency for the proposed system stays below 25 seconds even for complex dialogues; LLM-Rsum baseline exceeds 180 seconds per turn.
ledger.quote: our method achieves the lowest per-turn update latency, remaining below 25 seconds even for complex dialogues, while baseline systems incur much higher costs (e.g., LLM-Rsum exceeds 180 seconds per turn).
ledger.label: measured
